_comment: Voice roster for the AI4Bharat Orpheus Indic checkpoint: 40 speakers across all 22 scheduled Indian languages, 12 speaking styles. Language is selected by SPEAKER NAME (the prompt carries no language code), and every speaker name here is unique, which is what lets an OpenAI client pick a language using only the standard 'voice' field. 'sample' is example text in the native script, used for warmup and for docs.
